Dirty Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:14am

Ingredients




1 cup cold milk
1 pkg. Jello chocolate flavor instant pie filling
3 1/2 cups Cool Whip topping, thawed
20 chocolate sandwich cookies, crushed
1 1/2 cups Granola chunks
1 pkg. graham cracker pie crust

Preparation

1 Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix, beat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in topping. Stir in chips, cookies and pour all in pie crust. Freezes well.
